edited_statements.note: Pragmatism Lies Like a Corridor in a Hotel
edited_statements.before: As the young Italian pragmatist Papini has well said, it lies in the midst of our theories, like a corridor in a hotel.
edited_statements.after: As the young Italian pragmatist Papini has well said, pragmatism lies in the midst of our theories, like a corridor in a hotel.
edited_statements.why: "it" referred to pragmatism in another note; replaced with the source's own name "pragmatism" (name span with its own footnote). The original footnote quote is unchanged.

hard_calls: Statements 22-24 (pragmatic method refuses 'any such word') kept with the solving-names statements because 'such word' has no repairing name.
Statements 12-15 kept with 'a method only' because 'that method' cannot be repaired by a source name span.
Statement 30 ('All these ... tendencies') kept with the affinities list it refers to, so the corridor note begins at statement 34 with one name-span repair.
Statements 1-7 kept as one note (the pragmatist attitude) rather than splitting the empiricist claim from the turning-away/toward list.
